source_snapshot.procedure: Run `nvsm set powermode=maxp`, then `nvsm show powermode`.
source_snapshot.criteria: Switch without error and show correct current mode.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Exact syntax, baseline mode, headroom, monitoring and original-mode recovery required.

old_problem: DeepSeek changed the source command and guessed MaxQ recovery; the global persistent MaxP transition lacked capability, power/cooling headroom, effective-state checks and exact baseline restoration.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents the source-literal `nvsm set powermode=maxp` syntax and persistence. ED-03 allows platform capacity and monitoring limits as runtime prerequisites, while recovery is the captured original mode rather than a guessed opposite mode.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row348 all 18 XLSX columns and history2944.
Verified NVIDIA NVSM documentation for MaxP syntax, persistence and platform support limitations.
No power mode was changed and no DUT command ran.

test_case.test_name: Transactional NVSM MaxP mode transition and restoration
test_case.purpose: Set supported whole-system MaxP once, prove the requested persistent/effective state under safe capacity, then restore the exact recorded pre-test mode.
required_package: Pinned NVSM/DGX OS/BMC versions and MaxP capability proof
Independent power/thermal/error monitoring and abort limits
OOB access and original-mode restore plan
test_case.test_command: After explicit change approval, record `nvsm show powermode` and capacity/health baselines; execute source-literal `nvsm set powermode=maxp` once, verify reported and effective MaxP telemetry, then restore the captured original mode and verify final health.
test_case.expected_result: The approved system supports MaxP, the single set returns success, mode readback and effective indicators confirm MaxP without limit violation, and the exact original mode plus healthy services is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved capability/headroom, successful transition, effective-state evidence and verified exact restoration; a CLI zero exit or label alone is insufficient.
safety_gate: Explicit user approval for global persistent mode change
Verified PSU/feed/cooling margin and OOB path
Abort on PSU/fan/thermal/XID/AER/service anomaly; no auto-retry
expected_evidence: Original-mode restore and final service health
test_case.recovery: On any anomaly, stop workload, use OOB if needed, restore the captured original mode with the approved syntax, verify management/OS/GPU health, and do not retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Official documentation confirms the source syntax; review rejects DeepSeek's alternative syntax and assumed MaxQ rollback.

blocked.reason: The operation and recovery are defined; execution remains approval- and platform-input-gated.
